description: S30/H5 friend remark/alias (coverage-widening, hermetic): drive l3_set_friend_remark on the seeded echo-peer friend and prove a set/clear round-trips through l3_dump_state.friends[].remark. Sets a unique-nonce remark, asserts it appears in the friends list, clears it, asserts it's gone (state_not_contains). As of 2026-08 the tool WRITES through the real SDK boundary the friend-profile remark dialog uses (getFriendshipManager().setFriendInfo -> Tim2ToxSdkPlatform.setFriendInfo -> ExtendedPreferencesService.setFriendRemark, scoped by SharedPreferencesAdapter._prefixKey) while the dump READS through the other, independent scoping implementation (Prefs.getFriendRemark / Prefs._scopedKey). The round-trip is therefore a cross-implementation check of the two account-scoping key builders, not a write-then-read of one store. The remark is account-scoped local state, distinct from the Tox nickName. Self-cleans (ends with the remark cleared) even if interrupted. Hermetic — no echo round-trip. Maps to feature H5 / S30.
